name: Double elimination 4-team routing
description: Verify a 4-team double-elimination bracket routes every loser exactly once and reaches the grand final.
expected: Every team has a deterministic path and the lower-bracket winner reaches the grand final.

name: Double elimination 8-team reset
description: Verify an 8-team double-elimination bracket and conditional grand-final reset.
steps: Make the winners-bracket champion lose Grand Final 1
expected: Losers route deterministically and the reset activates only when the winners-bracket champion loses Grand Final 1.

name: Backup create and verify
description: Verify an authorized administrator can create and read back a backup snapshot.
expected: A manifest exists and storage verification succeeds.

name: Admin team manager account creation
description: Verify a Super Admin can create a Team Manager account assigned to a team and that the manager can sign in to the manager portal.
steps: Open Managers in the admin control room
Enter a manager email and select a team
Sign out and sign in through Team Manager
Verify the assigned team is displayed
expected: The manager account is created with the selected team assignment and the manager can access only the assigned team's manager portal.

name: Team manager can update assigned roster
description: Verify a Team Manager can access the assigned team portal and update its roster without accessing other teams.
steps: Sign in as a Team Manager
Update a roster member on the assigned team
expected: The assigned team's roster update persists and no other team's data is exposed.

name: Admin map result entry
description: Verify an administrator can record map-level results for the three CODM modes and those results persist into team statistics.
steps: Sign in as an authorized administrator
Open Match management for a tournament with a generated match
Enter Hardpoint, Search and Destroy, and Control map wins for both teams
expected: The saved match contains the three map-mode results and the affected teams show updated Hardpoint, Search and Destroy, and Control win percentages.

name: Team quick stats on hover
description: Verify a public team card reveals a compact roster and performance snapshot when hovered or focused.
steps: Hover or focus a team card
Verify roster, wins, win rate, matches, best placement, points, Hardpoint, Search and Destroy, and Control win rates are shown
expected: The selected team card reveals its quick stats, including the three map-mode win percentages, without requiring login.
